title: 🧲 Magnetic Hoppers
description: Save Iron: 1 Hopper now does the work of 49 Hoppers!Reduce Lag: Fewer hoppers means significantly less lag on your world or server.Perfect for Farms: Automatically vacuums up drops from mob grinders, iron farms, and auto-harvesting setups.
body: What does it do? This lightweight Vanilla+ Data Pack upgrades every hopper in your world. Hoppers will now actively scan a massive 7x7 area (up to 3 blocks away horizontally and vertically) and magically "suck" dropped items directly into their inventory.
